title: Establishment of VDVKs in Tribal Areas of Rajasthan
body_text:
Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed today in Lok Sabha that the population and percentage of Scheduled Tribes across Udaipur, Dungarpur, Pratapgarh, Banswara, Sirohi, Salumbar, Rajsamand and Chittorgarh districts of Rajasthan, block-wise is given at Annexure I .
Under Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM) a total of 283 Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) covering 85,349 beneficiaries have been sanctioned in Udaipur, Salumbar, Dungarpur and Pratapgarh districts of Rajasthan. The beneficiaries are engaged in the value addition, processing and marketing of locally available Minor Forest Produce (MFP) and agricultural produce such as graded wheat, wheat flour, daliya, maize, chana/chana dal, moong dal, urad dal, mango pickle (aam achar), turmeric powder, chilli powder, honey, soyabean products, herbal and amla-based products. The district-wise details of the sanctioned VDVKs are as under:
District No. of VDVKs sanctioned No. of beneficiaries benefitted Udaipur 110 33,189 Salumbar 39 11,826 Dungarpur 72 21,672 Pratapgarh 62 18,662 TOTAL 283 85,349
State Implementing Agency of Rajasthan has supplied toolkits to the VDVKs and an amount of ₹2253 lakhs (approx.) has been released to the VDVKs for training and toolkits.

enrichment.summary: In a Lok Sabha reply on 13 August 2026, the Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs stated that 283 Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) have been sanctioned under the Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM) across Udaipur, Salumbar, Dungarpur and Pratapgarh districts of Rajasthan, benefiting 85,349 tribal beneficiaries. These VDVKs support value addition and marketing of Minor Forest Produce and agricultural produce like wheat, dals, pickles, honey and herbal products. About ₹2,253 lakh has been released for toolkits and training, and the reply also furnished block-wise Scheduled Tribe population data (Census 2011) for eight tribal-dominated Rajasthan districts.
enrichment.context:
The Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM), earlier known as the Mechanism for Marketing of Minor Forest Produce (MFP) through Minimum Support Price and Development of Value Chain, aims to improve tribal livelihoods by adding value to locally sourced minor forest produce and agricultural goods. Van Dhan Vikas Kendras are cluster-based, community-owned enterprises (typically comprising 15-20 Van Dhan Self-Help Groups, each with about 20 tribal gatherers/artisans) set up under this mission to provide primary processing, value addition, and market linkage infrastructure at the grassroots level, thereby reducing tribal dependence on middlemen and raw produce sales. TRIFED (Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India), under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, is the nodal agency overseeing implementation through State Implementing Agencies.

Rajasthan's southern tribal belt—including Udaipur, Dungarpur, Banswara, Pratapgarh and the newly carved Salumbar district—has a substantial Bhil and other Scheduled Tribe population, some blocks recording over 90% ST concentration, making it a key focus area for tribal welfare and forest-based livelihood schemes. This region falls within the Fifth Schedule areas of India, which have special constitutional provisions for tribal governance and land protection. Data on district and block-wise ST population, often drawn from Census 2011 pending the next census, is frequently used in Parliament to justify targeted welfare interventions like PMJVM and to assess implementation gaps.

prelims_questions.question: The 'Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs)' mentioned in news are established under which of the following schemes?
prelims_questions.explanation: VDVKs are set up under the Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM), which supports value addition and marketing of Minor Forest Produce by tribal communities.

prelims_questions.question: Which nodal central agency, functioning under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, is primarily responsible for implementing the Van Dhan Vikas Kendra scheme through State Implementing Agencies?
options: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation
TRIFED (Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India)
prelims_questions.explanation: TRIFED is the nodal implementing agency for schemes related to marketing and value addition of Minor Forest Produce, including Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
